pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word means "parents"? (1 mark)
   A. die Tanten
   B. die Eltern
   C. die Kinder
   D. die Geschwister

2. What does "der Sonntag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Sunday
   C. Wednesday
   D. week

3. What does "das Lied" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. song
   B. cake
   C. candle
   D. birthday

4. Which sentence says your age correctly? (1 mark)
   A. Ich heiße zehn.
   B. Ich bin zehn Kuchen.
   C. Ich habe heute zehn.
   D. Ich bin heute zehn.

5. What does "die Milch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. carrot
   B. cocoa
   C. milk
   D. mango

6. What does "der Zucker" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cabbage or kale
   B. watermelon
   C. maize
   D. sugar

7. Which sentence tells that someone likes rice and beans? (1 mark)
   A. Ich koche Reis und Bohnen nicht.
   B. Ich esse gern Reis und Bohnen.
   C. Wo ist der Reis?
   D. Ich habe kein Reis.

8. What does "das Knie" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. ear
   B. knee
   C. finger
   D. neck

9. How is the letter ö made? (1 mark)
   A. Say ee with wide lips
   B. Say oh with wide lips
   C. Say ay with round lips
   D. Say ow

10. What does "die Sonne" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. wind
   B. thunderstorm
   C. sun
   D. snow

11. What does "manchmal" mean? (1 mark)
   A. sometimes
   B. never
   C. always
   D. often

12. What does "singen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to hear
   B. to read
   C. to drink
   D. to sing

13. What does "die Mutter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. brothers and sisters
   B. mother
   C. family
   D. parents

14. Which little word goes with the noun "Messer"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. der
   D. das

15. What does "vor dem Haus" mean? (1 mark)
   A. under the house
   B. in front of the house
   C. behind the house
   D. in the house

16. What does "die Toilette" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. toilet
   B. bedroom
   C. shower
   D. lamp

17. What does "der Samstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Tuesday
   C. weekend
   D. Saturday

18. Which day comes right before Samstag? (1 mark)
   A. Mittwoch
   B. Donnerstag
   C. Freitag
   D. Montag

19. What does "Januar" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. March
   B. April
   C. January
   D. May

20. Which German word is the number 2? (1 mark)
   A. zwei
   B. neunzehn
   C. achtzehn
   D. drei

21. What is the plural of "die Banane"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bananen
   B. die Banane
   C. die Bananes
   D. die Bananer

22. Which food group does "die Kartoffel" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. das Obst
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Gemüse

23. What does "der Zahn" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. toe
   B. back
   C. tooth
   D. hair

24. What is the plural of "das Bein"? (1 mark)
   A. die Beiner
   B. die Beinen
   C. die Beine
   D. die Beins

25. What does "sonnig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. dry
   B. cool
   C. sunny
   D. foggy

26. What does "kalt" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cool
   B. sunny
   C. hot
   D. cold

27. Which German word or phrase means "How are you?"? (1 mark)
   A. Wie geht's?
   B. Ja
   C. Guten Abend
   D. Guten Tag

28. What does "Und dir?" mean? (1 mark)
   A. And who?
   B. And me?
   C. And where?
   D. And you?

29. Where does the comma go in "Meine Oma ist alt aber nett"? (1 mark)
   A. after Oma
   B. before aber
   C. after ist
   D. after nett

30. Which little word goes with the noun "Topf"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. die
   D. der

31. Which German word or phrase means "living room"? (1 mark)
   A. der Topf
   B. das Wohnzimmer
   C. die Uhr
   D. der Stuhl

32. What is a "Lieblingszimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. a cold room
   B. a favourite room
   C. a new room
   D. a big room

33. What does "lesen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to have a shower
   B. to speak
   C. to read
   D. to drink

34. Which German word or phrase means "birthday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Luftballon
   B. der Geburtstag
   C. die Party
   D. die Kerze

35. Which sentence is correctly written? (1 mark)
   A. Ich möchtet tanzen.
   B. Ich möchte tanzt.
   C. Ich möchte tanze.
   D. Ich möchte tanzen.

36. Which German word or phrase means "watermelon"? (1 mark)
   A. die Tomate
   B. das Fleisch
   C. der Apfel
   D. die Wassermelone

37. Which little word goes with the noun "Tomate"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. der
   D. das

38. Which German word or phrase means "orange"? (1 mark)
   A. die Milch
   B. das Wasser
   C. die Wassermelone
   D. die Orange

39. Which little word goes with the noun "Wetter"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. der
   D. die

40. Which German word or phrase means "thunderstorm"? (1 mark)
   A. das Wetter
   B. der Regenbogen
   C. das Gewitter
   D. die Wolke

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain what the colon, the question mark and the exclamation mark tell us when reading aloud. (3 marks)

42. Write three sentences about your body in German. (3 marks)

43. Write the numbers 3, 9 and 12 in German. (3 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear. (3 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: toe, song, juice, egg, water. (5 marks)

46. Write the German words with der, die or das for: garden, room, sun, thunderstorm. (4 marks)

47. Write three sentences in German about your father or mother: name, age and one adjective. (3 marks)

48. Match the body part to what it does: Auge, Ohr, Nase. (3 marks)

49. Write a short weather report in German with a greeting, weather and a goodbye. (4 marks)

50. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cloud, cake, toe. (3 marks)

51. You hear "Auf dem Mount Kenya ist es kalt. Dort schneit es manchmal." What is the gist? (2 marks)

52. Write the German words with der, die or das for: daughter, orange. (2 marks)

53. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear, cloud, cake. (5 marks)

54. Explain how to pronounce ß, sch and z, with one example each. (3 marks)

55. Unscramble and write with the article: FELPA and SERI. (4 marks)

56. Write three sentences in German that say where things are in your room. (3 marks)

57. Write these numbers in German: 2, 6, 10. (3 marks)

58. Write the German words with der, die or das for: fork, wall. (2 marks)

59. Write the German sound for each letter group: ei and ie. Give an example word for each. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — die Eltern
   Eltern are the mother and father together.

2. B — Sunday
   der Sonntag means Sunday.

3. A — song
   das Lied means song.

4. D — Ich bin heute zehn.
   With age we use ich bin.

5. C — milk
   die Milch means milk.

6. D — sugar
   der Zucker means sugar.

7. B — Ich esse gern Reis und Bohnen.
   gern shows that the person likes it.

8. B — knee
   das Knie means knee.

9. C — Say ay with round lips
   ö is made with the lips rounded.

10. C — sun
   die Sonne means sun.

11. A — sometimes
   manchmal means sometimes.

12. D — to sing
   singen means to sing.

13. B — mother
   die Mutter means mother.

14. D — das
   It is das Messer, so the little word is das.

15. B — in front of the house
   vor means in front of.

16. A — toilet
   die Toilette means toilet.

17. D — Saturday
   der Samstag means Saturday.

18. C — Freitag
   Before Samstag comes Freitag.

19. C — January
   Januar means January.

20. A — zwei
   2 in German is zwei.

21. A — die Bananen
   The plural of die Banane is die Bananen.

22. D — das Gemüse
   die Kartoffel belongs to das Gemüse.

23. C — tooth
   der Zahn means tooth.

24. C — die Beine
   The plural of das Bein is die Beine.

25. C — sunny
   sonnig means sunny.

26. D — cold
   kalt means cold.

27. A — Wie geht's?
   How are you? in German is Wie geht's?.

28. D — And you?
   Und dir? asks the same question back.

29. B — before aber
   A comma is written before aber.

30. D — der
   It is der Topf, so the little word is der.

31. B — das Wohnzimmer
   living room in German is das Wohnzimmer.

32. B — a favourite room
   Liebling means favourite and Zimmer means room.

33. C — to read
   lesen means to read.

34. B — der Geburtstag
   birthday in German is der Geburtstag.

35. D — Ich möchte tanzen.
   After möchte comes the -en form tanzen.

36. D — die Wassermelone
   watermelon in German is die Wassermelone.

37. B — die
   It is die Tomate, so the little word is die.

38. D — die Orange
   orange in German is die Orange.

39. A — das
   It is das Wetter, so the little word is das.

40. C — das Gewitter
   thunderstorm in German is das Gewitter.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: The colon announces a list or speech, the question mark tells us to raise the voice and the exclamation mark shows strong feeling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich habe zwei Augen. Das ist meine Nase. Mit den Ohren höre ich.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: drei, neun, zwölf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

45. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Zeh, das Lied, der Saft, das Ei, das Wasser.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Garten, das Zimmer, die Sonne, das Gewitter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist 35 Jahre alt. Sie ist nett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Auge = sehen, Ohr = hören, Nase = riechen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

49. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Guten Morgen! Heute ist es sonnig und warm. Es ist nicht windig. Tschüss!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for weather sentences, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for the goodbye.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Wolke, der Kuchen, der Zeh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is cold on Mount Kenya and sometimes it snows there.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for cold, 1 mark for snow.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Tochter, die Orange.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

53. (5 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr, die Wolke, der Kuchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: ß is a strong ss (Fuß). sch is sh (Schulter). z is ts (Zahn).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Apfel and der Reis.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist an der Wand. Der Tisch ist neben dem Bett. Die Tasche ist unter dem Tisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: zwei, sechs, zehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Gabel, die Wand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: ei sounds like eye (nein). ie sounds like ee (Tier).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sound with an example.
